t: Section 431(a) of title 10, United States Code, is amended by striking “December 31, 2017” and inserting “December 31, 2023”.

fable.w: This section only extends a sunset date in 10 U.S.C. 431(a) from 2017 to 2023. It contains no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, rulemaking, or right to sue; there is no tempting reading that would bring a non-federal party into a federal decision.
fable.s: is amended by striking “December 31, 2017” and inserting “December 31, 2023”

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple technical amendment that extends a deadline or authorization period. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public hearings, or requirements for outside input mentioned.
qwen_block.s: Section 431(a) of title 10, United States Code, is amended by striking “December 31, 2017” and inserting “December 31, 2023”.

opus.w: The section only extends an expiration date in an existing statute. It does not require or allow consultation with anyone outside the federal government, and it creates no hearing, comment period, rulemaking, advisory body or right to sue. A reader might assume that amending a grant of agency authority implies some process, but this text adds none.
opus.s: Section 431(a) of title 10, United States Code, is amended by striking “December 31, 2017” and inserting “December 31, 2023”.
